text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is an ecological niche modeling study focused on the species distribution of an invasive plant, Rhododendron ponticum, in Snowdonia National Park, Wales. Although it includes a simulated land cover map for 2050 used as an environmental predictor, the primary research objective is NOT land use/land cover (LULC) prediction at a national scale, but rather to model current and future habitat suitability of a species. The study area is a national park (regional/local scale), not an entire country. The land cover projection is based on a single scenario using a simple Markov-chain neural network approach without contrasting multiple socio-economic scenarios, and it is used only as one input in a species distribution model. The paper does not present a primary focus on LULC change modeling or detailed LULC prediction with quantitative accuracy metrics for land cover itself. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criteria for national-scale LULC prediction as a primary research focus and meets exclusion criteria for species-specific ecological focus unrelated to LULC prediction.)
